propositions: Rebar lacks a native Bedrock provider path; current workaround (OpenAI gateway proxy) sacrifices prompt caching and native structured output.
Bedrock inference profiles support prompt caching but silent failures occur when cache_read and cache_write are both zero despite non-zero input tokens, requiring a dedicated warning predicate.

Bedrock models reject temperature parameter with 400 ValidationException for some model IDs (e.g., us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7), but pydantic-ai's _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings exists only in anthropic.py leaf, not bedrock.py, leaving Bedrock unprotected.

Exact-model-id capability overrides are needed to distinguish temperature support per Bedrock model, keyed on measured API defects rather than provider-name matching, applied after profile-shaped overrides.

Builder must be isolated to new src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py leaf to respect providers.py's 300-LOC cap; runner.py needs headroom (currently at hard 800-LOC cap) for cache warning and temperature omission logic, blocked on task 2682-b015-4fe5-4066 split.

On-demand Bedrock model IDs are not invokable in test account; inference-profile ARN us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 verified caching; silent non-caching observed on opus-4-5 variants; live measurements in 896586841071/us-east-1 required before production cutover (story eb6e).
